statistics.metric: The number of successes/all attempts to fix the candidate library with the same protocol, and the pre-screening refusal is included in the denominator
statistics.note: Success must pass through the original impact door, and at least 0.2 seconds of continuous hand contact at the end, and the conservative bottle bottom must be at least 3 cm away from the table.
